subject: [hw] DONE K02 rev 2
body:
Three hardening changes after the first DONE (no review finding yet; they came out of re-reading the failure paths):
1. Power-off no longer touches the gate registers of a block that is on but not usable (protected/isolated): it skips the gate write and goes straight to protection/SRAM/power-down. Previously a failed power-on that had left protection set would have written gate registers while bus-protected (unsafe on hardware, and a model violation).
2. A power-on that fails the final "out of reset/isolation, protection released" check now unwinds with a full power-off instead of leaving a half-powered domain behind.
3. A minor-0 INFO ioctl no longer takes the relay lock while holding the device lock (the relay lock order is documented as n2vc_lock -> n2vr_lock being allowed by IK; now it is not nested at all).
Also: DMA access denials and the minor-1 policy return EACCES (matching IKs relay), not EPERM; the host test cases were updated.

Current last line, both builds (-O1 ASan+UBSan and -O2):
    N2TEST K02 PASS 588732/588732 (violations 0)
Command: bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh
Kernel staged compile (q10at3 + 0298 + IKs 0299 with the current relay/jpegdev) still clean with the CI flags, 0 unknown undefined symbols. IKs compile_check now passes with this file. STATUS.md and VCODEC_HW.md updated with the count.
